steamdeckbranch.description: TEMPORARY BRANCH - Makes the game compatible with steamdeck, but has a bug where you can no longer click on bees if you pause the game, and have to exit to level select to be able to click on bees again. This is fixed in the current build but it has another bug I wish to fix first before publishing it.
